name: You Want Some?
overview:
Every girl Jae Hyeon liked has always liked Sun U. Feeling inferior, Jae Hyeon explodes in front of Sun U, to which he suggests if 'he wants a taste'. So starts a love battle between the two men, where the loser is the one to confess first.

Jae Hyeon is slowly attracted to Sun U's deep flirting, will he be able to win the love battle?
